slides.title: Attention Is All You Need
slides.subtitle: The Transformer Architecture — A New Paradigm for Sequence Transduction

slides.title: Problem & Motivation
bullets: RNN/LSTM/GRU-based models dominate seq2seq but are inherently sequential → cannot parallelize
Attention mechanisms used only as adjuncts to RNNs, not as the core computation
Goal: Eliminate recurrence entirely; design a model based solely on attention
Introduce the Transformer: first transduction model relying entirely on self-attention

slides.title: Model Architecture Overview
bullets: Encoder-Decoder structure with N=6 identical layers each
Encoder: Multi-head self-attention → Position-wise FFN (+ residual & layer norm)
Decoder: Masked self-attention → Cross-attention (over encoder) → FFN
All sub-layers produce d_model=512 outputs; Residual: LayerNorm(x + Sublayer(x))
Scaled Dot-Product Attention: Attention(Q,K,V) = softmax(QK^T/√d_k)V

slides.title: Multi-Head Attention & Positional Encoding
bullets: Multi-Head: 8 parallel attention heads (d_k=d_v=64 per head), concatenated & projected
Allows joint attention to information from different representation subspaces
No recurrence → must encode position: sinusoidal positional encodings (sin/cos of varying frequencies)
FFN: ReLU(xW₁+b₁)W₂+b₂ with inner dimension d_ff=2048

slides.title: Key Results & Why Self-Attention
bullets: EN-DE WMT 2014: 28.4 BLEU (new SOTA, beats all ensembles by >2 BLEU)
EN-FR WMT 2014: 41.8 BLEU (single-model SOTA at 1/4 training cost)
Self-attention: O(1) path length vs O(n) for RNNs — better long-range dependencies
Fully parallelizable: O(1) sequential ops vs O(n) for RNNs
Interpretable attention heads learn syntactic & semantic structure
English constituency parsing: 92.7 F1 (semi-supervised)

slides.title: Conclusion & Impact
bullets: First sequence transduction model based entirely on attention — no RNN or CNN
Trains significantly faster: 12 hours (base) / 3.5 days (big) on 8 P100 GPUs
New SOTA on both WMT 2014 EN-DE and EN-FR translation tasks
Generalizes well to other tasks (parsing) without task-specific tuning
Code: https://github.com/tensorflow/tensor2tensor
Foundation for modern LLMs (BERT, GPT, T5, etc.)
